executeSQL(cmd, connection, input, output);

sql.query: select a.lecture_seq_no, title, amount, summary, dbo.formatDateTime(reg_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd') reg_dt, s.std_yyyy, s.start_dd, s.end_dd, s.std_end_dd, case when ( cast( s.end_dd + ' 19:59:59' as datetime) - getdate() ) > 0 then (case when ( getdate() -cast( s.start_dd + ' 00:00:00' as datetime) ) < 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end) else 'Y' end as teminate_yn, a.lecture_div from tb_cyber_lecture a , tb_cyber_system s where 1=1 --and a.use_yn = 'Y' and a.lecture_seq_no = s.lecture_seq_no and s.active_yn = 'Y' order by lecture_seq_no

select a.lecture_seq_no, title, amount, summary, dbo.formatDateTime(reg_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd') reg_dt, dbo.formatDateTime(cast( s.end_dd + ' 23:59:59' as datetime),'yyyy.mm.dd') end_dd, (case when ( cast( s.end_dd + ' 20:59:59' as datetime) - getdate() ) > 0 then 'N' else 'Y' end) as time_over, a.lecture_div from tb_cyber_lecture a, tb_cyber_system s where a.LECTURE_SEQ_NO = s.LECTURE_SEQ_NO --and a.use_yn = 'Y' and a.lecture_seq_no = ? and s.active_yn = 'Y'

SELECT top $rnum lecture_seq_no, title, amount, summary, dbo.formatDateTime(reg_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd') reg_dt, tot_cnt, std_yyyy,start_dd,end_dd,std_end_dd, lecture_div FROM ( select a.lecture_seq_no, title, amount, summary, reg_dt, ROW_NUMBER() over( order by a.reg_dt desc) rnum, COUNT(a.lecture_seq_no) over() tot_cnt, s.std_yyyy, s.start_dd, s.end_dd, s.std_end_dd, a.lecture_div from tb_cyber_lecture a, tb_cyber_system s where 1=1 --and a.use_yn = 'Y' and a.lecture_seq_no = s.lecture_seq_no and s.active_yn = 'Y'
)a where a.rnum > (?-1)*?

select x.lecture_seq_no, x.title, x.amount, x.summary, x.reg_dt, x.status, x.status_nm, x.user_lecture_seq_no, x.user_lecture_start_dt, x.user_lecture_end_dt, datediff( ss , getdate() , x.user_lecture_end_dt ) diff, case when ( cast( x.user_lecture_end_dt as datetime) - getdate() ) < 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end as end_yn, (select count(class_no) from tb_cyber_user_class t where t.user_lecture_seq_no = x.user_lecture_seq_no ) class_cnt, (select min(user_class_seq_no) from tb_cyber_user_class t where t.user_lecture_seq_no = x.user_lecture_seq_no ) user_class_seq_no, x.std_yyyy, x.end_dd, x.std_end_dd, x.lecture_div from( select c.lecture_seq_no, c.title, c.amount, c.summary, dbo.formatDateTime(c.reg_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd') reg_dt, a.status, s.std_yyyy, s.end_dd, s.std_end_dd, case a.status when '00' then '수강전' when '01' then '수강중' when '02' then '평가중' when '03' then '완료' when '09' then '실격' else '삭제' END AS status_nm, a.user_lecture_seq_no, dbo.formatDateTime( (case a.status when '00' then getdate() else a.user_lecture_start_dt end),'yyyy.mm.dd HH:MI') user_lecture_start_dt, dbo.formatDateTime( case when (cast(s.std_end_dd as int) - cast( dbo.formatDateTime( (case a.status when '00' then getdate() else a.user_lecture_start_dt end)+(13 + ISNULL(a.extend_cnt,0) * 13 ) ,'yyyymmdd') as int)) < 0 then s.std_end_dd + ' 23:59:59' else (case a.status when '00' then getdate() else a.user_lecture_start_dt end)+(13 + ISNULL(a.extend_cnt,0) * 13 ) end ,'yyyy.mm.dd HH:MI') as user_lecture_end_dt, c.lecture_div from TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE a LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_SYSTEM s ON a.lecture_seq_no = s.lecture_seq_no AND a.std_yyyy = s.std_yyyy ,TB_CYBER_LECTURE c WHERE a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no AND a.status <> '99' --AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.user_lecture_seq_no = ? ) x

SELECT top(1) a.brd_mng_no, a.brd_no, ttl, cntnt, (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_kabm_attach_file WHERE data_no = a.brd_no and attach_div_cd ='attach_div_03') > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS is_exist_file, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),a.reg_ddtm, 120) as reg_dt, (SELECT emp_nm FROM tb_kabm_emp WHERE emp_cd= a.reg_emp_cd) as emp_nm FROM tb_kabm_board a WHERE a.brd_mng_no = ? AND a.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY a.reg_ddtm desc

mapping.getProperty: brd_mng_no, brd_no, ttl, cntnt, is_exist_file, reg_dt, emp_nm

sql.query: select top 1 a.user_lecture_seq_no, a.lecture_seq_no, c.lecture_div from TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE a LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_LECTURE c ON a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no LEFT JOIN ( select user_lecture_seq_no , min( t.study_start_dt) start_dt , max( t.estimate_end_dt ) end_dt from TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS t where status <> '9' group by user_lecture_seq_no) d ON a.user_lecture_seq_no = d.user_lecture_seq_no LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS e ON a.curr_class_no = e.user_class_seq_no LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_SYSTEM s ON a.lecture_seq_no = s.lecture_seq_no AND a.std_yyyy = s.std_yyyy WHERE a.user_seq_no = ? AND a.status = '02' ORDER BY start_dt desc
